dedupe_keys.name: battle of the water futures wdsa ccwi 2026 data and software

description: The Battle of the Water Futures is the benchmark competition of the Battle of the Water Networks series held at the WDSA/CCWI 2026 conference in Paphos, Cyprus (18 to 21 May 2026). Participants design and operate a water distribution system over a long planning horizon under deep uncertainty, applying interventions in stages, with elements of policymaking and artificial intelligence; solutions are scored by a transparent evaluator released with the data. The repository holds the Python package, network and utility data, masterplans, examples and the evaluator; releases ran from version 0.1.0 (8 December 2025) to 1.1.0 (28 April 2026) and are archived on Zenodo, with the problem described on arXiv. It is organised by a team of the ERC-funded Water-Futures project, with contact through KWR, under the MIT licence. Caveats: coverage is one synthetic system and its futures, not a real utility, the rules changed between stages of the competition, and results were not yet read. Simulation uses: testing long-term capacity planning, optimisation and climate adaptation of water distribution systems under uncertainty. Related records: BattLeDIM (data-battledim-leakage-detection-benchmark) and EPANET (model-epanet).
